summary_notes: Outbound sales discovery call with Marguerite, director of operations at Tidewell Home Care (home health agency, ~85 total users after correcting from 60 to include 25 per-diem contractors). Current tools: spreadsheets, whiteboard, shared calendar, group texts; leaving current vendor after a spring data breach; vendor contract ends January 15, so they must be live before then. Top pain points: handoffs and staff location visibility; rural offline connectivity is important. Pricing discussed: Team $14/seat/mo, Enterprise $26/seat/mo, annual billing; rep authorized up to 15% discount. Compliance officer Theodora has final sign-off on anything touching patient data; security review set for Tue Oct 6, 10 a.m. Proposal for 85 seats due Friday. Rep disclosed a client's confidential pricing and gave contradictory BAA information.
